_comment: Firebase project config. NO HOSTING BLOCK ON PURPOSE — the app deploys to GitHub Pages (`npm run deploy`, gh-pages -d dist) and Vite builds it under base /nba-showdown-2k25/. Adding Firebase Hosting here would give two live copies of the game at two URLs, with only one of them the one anybody uses. NOTHING HERE IS DEPLOYED YET — see functions/README.md for what deploying costs and what it breaks if done out of order. The predeploy hook copies the game modules into functions/shared so the server and the browser run the SAME pack engine; see functions/prepare.mjs for why a copy rather than a symlink or a path import. THE HOOK DELIBERATELY USES A PLAIN RELATIVE PATH: the documented form is `node "$RESOURCE_DIR/prepare.mjs"`, and $RESOURCE_DIR is POSIX syntax that cmd.exe does not expand, so on Windows the hook runs literally, node cannot find the module, and the very first deploy aborts. firebase-tools runs hooks from the directory holding this file, and prepare.mjs resolves its own paths from import.meta.url, so a relative path is correct on every platform.
